+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_BASE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
+
+
+def poll_transcription(job_id: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, timeout: int = 30) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    response = requests.get(
+        f"{OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_BASE_URL}/audio/transcriptions/{job_id}",
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"},
+        timeout=timeout,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("status") in {"completed", "succeeded"}:
+        return {"transcript": data.get("text") or data.get("transcript") or data}
+    return data
+
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import mimetypes
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions"
+OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL = "gpt-4o-transcribe"
+
+
+def submit_transcription(audio_path: str, model: str = OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL, language: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
+    mime_type, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(audio_path)
+    if mime_type is None:
+        mime_type = "application/octet-stream"
+
+    with open(audio_path, "rb") as audio_file:
+        files = {
+            "file": (os.path.basename(audio_path), audio_file, mime_type),
+        }
+        data = {"model": model}
+        if language:
+            data["language"] = language
+
+        response = requests.post(
+            OPENAI_TRANSCRIPTION_URL,
+            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"},
+            files=files,
+            data=data,
+            timeout=120,
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.json()
+
*** End Patch
